description: Defines template classes for WebSocket link handling, including WebSocket server and client link types, with support for WebSocket protocol upgrade, message serialization/deserialization, and link state management within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: HWebSocketLinkType
classes.description: Template class managing WebSocket link states, message handling, upgrade process, and data transmission for client and server WebSocket links.

classes.name: HWebSocketServerType
classes.description: Template class representing a WebSocket server, managing WebSocket connections and data flow.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns reference to the underlying link object.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier string.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier string.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the link is open.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the link is suspended.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the link is closed.

methods.name: IsWebServer
methods.description: Checks if the link is a web server.

methods.name: IsUpgrading
methods.description: Checks if the link is in upgrading state.

methods.name: IsWebSocket
methods.description: Checks if the link is a WebSocket.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the link has completed its operation.

methods.name: Binary
methods.description: Sets or gets binary mode.

methods.name: Masking
methods.description: Sets or gets masking mode.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Initiates WebSocket upgrade with protocol, path, query, and origin.

methods.name: AbortUpgrade
methods.description: Aborts the upgrade process with status and reason.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the WebSocket connection with a wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection with a wait time.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the link to process data.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes pending messages.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an outbound message.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Abstract method to process inbound link body.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Abstract method to process inbound messages.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Abstract method to send outbound messages.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Abstract method to process received data.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Abstract method to send data.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Abstract method to handle state changes.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Abstract method to check if link is idle.
